Each is `{ path, label?, as?, format?, map?, itemPath?, parts?, separator?, route?, variant?, variantMap? }`. `as` is `row` (default when `label` is set), `title`, `line` or `pill`. `format` is `text` (default), `date` (board short date), `date-long` (always with the year) or `list` (an array joined by ", ", each item read at `itemPath`). `map` turns a raw value into a label (translated). `parts` (on a `line`) lists paths, or `{ path, label?, format? }`, joined by `separator` (default " · "); empty parts are dropped. - `source` — `{ register, schema, id }` or `{ url }`; omitted = the current object. - `link` — `{ label, route? \| href? }` at the foot. - `hideEmpty` — drop an entry whose value is empty (default true). - `emptyText` — shown when no entry has a value. |
